claims.text: The log shows repeated successful API requests to list servers (status 200) from a Nova‑API process at 00:07:26–00:07:31 on May 16 2017, followed by a separate entry indicating that a VM with instance ID 63a0d960‑70b6‑44c6‑b606‑491478a5cadf was stopped as a lifecycle event at 00:07:27.
This suggests the API responded to client queries about server details and that one virtual machine underwent a stop operation during that timeframe.
